title: Ocean Marine / Watercraft policy
fideon:note: Generated from the supplied Watercraft schema v3.0.0 by scripts/build_canonical_policy_schemas.py, filed under `ocean_marine`. config/lob_registry.yaml decides that boats, watercraft and yachts ARE this line and that a second code would be another name for it. The previous hand-written file pointed five different sections at one 21-field `Item` definition, so it asserted that an operator and a form each have a hull material and a top speed. Do not hand-edit; edit the source and regenerate. Extended by scripts/canonical_schema_extensions.py with fields the supplied skeleton did not carry; re-run it after any regeneration. Hand-extended 2026-09-24 with fields and aliases seen in the Markel watercraft declarations and HawkSoft policy-history PDFs (scripts/ is not in this repo); carry these over if the file is regenerated. Hand-extended again 2026-09-24 with registration_number, operator years_of_experience/license_type/association_membership, premium paid_in_full_premium/total_discounts and billing remittance_address/phone, seen in the Progressive and Travelers boat PDFs; carry these over too. Hand-extended a third time 2026-09-24 after checking all six ocean_marine PDFs: billing payable_to/payment_options, navigation seasonal_restrictions, loss_history_none_reported, operators no_violations_reported, moorage_season, contact phone_type, document source_url/print_time, and aliases for labels those PDFs print; carry these over too. Aliases added 2026-09-24 for every remaining heading and label the six ocean_marine PDFs print. Aliases and the renewal_offer expiring_policy_expiration_date field added 2026-09-24 after auditing the six ocean_marine samples against their gold; "Clients" moved from contact.contact_name to additional_named_insureds; carry these over too. Fields watercraft[].personal_effects_limit, policy.policy_period_location_basis, document.print_code and billing.payment_coupon_scan_line added 2026-09-24, the last printed items of the six ocean_marine PDFs without a field; carry these over too. text_sections (with $defs.TextSection, as in dwelling_fire.json), policy.product_code and billing.billing_note added 2026-09-24 so the printed prose and the last unkeyed values of the six ocean_marine PDFs have a home; carry these over too.

date.note: US insurance documents print dates month/day/year, so every date's parsed value is MM/DD/YYYY: two-digit month and day, four-digit year, whatever the page prints (5/6/26, May 6, 2026 and 2026-05-06 are all parsed as 05/06/2026). raw stays exactly as printed. applies_to matches field names such as effective_date, date_of_birth and replaces_prior_declaration_dated. A form edition_date ("04/07") has no day and keeps its printed form. A value that is not a calendar date ("Full Prior Acts", "None") has parsed null. Compare dates as dates, not strings: as text, 12/31/2025 sorts after 01/01/2026 - this includes the date_ordering audit rules.

TextSection.description: A block of printed text exactly as the document carries it: a prose paragraph, notice, condition or disclaimer, or the page's remaining label/footer text. Nothing the page prints is left out of the gold; structured fields above hold the values, these hold the words.
